prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, four women in a single row.

A photograph of FOUR women standing side by side in a city bus with worn vinyl seats in rows on both sides, yellow handrails along the ceiling, large windows showing blurred daylight streets, a scuffed ribbed rubber floor. Behind them, several ordinary passengers sitting in the seats and holding the handrails are softly out of focus, their figures and faces blurred by shallow depth of field into gentle shapes and colours, while the women stay razor sharp in the foreground, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 4 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, soft daylight from the bus windows raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Far-left woman: a real adult Latina woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, a calm, composed expression, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes. Long almond nails, matte finish.

Far-left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Far-left woman's body art: painted in Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif — a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals, wide gold bands following every deep crease, dense folk-art floral motifs filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Far-left woman's restraints: Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, and from the middle of that short chain a longer chain of the same links runs to a huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as a bowling ball that rests on the floor beside her feet. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, joined by a short chain of the same links, her hands hanging low in front of her hips.

Far-left woman's pose: standing full height, facing the camera, close beside the other women, her shoulders slightly lowered, her head bowed a little, her bare feet close together flat on the floor, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Far-left woman's footwear: bare feet flat on the floor.

Lighting: the light carving every fold and curve on all 4, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 landscape 8K.
